thread:
Incident Bot: [PAGING] Dedicated EU cluster (ded-eu-3) elevated: >10% 5xx on embeddings/transform endpoints for account:Nereid Financial :rotating_light:
Incident Bot: Alert ID: ded-eu-3-504s-1876543210 | detected_at: 2025-11-12T14:00:10Z | severity: high | suggested action: oncall-ack + run failover routing
María (oncall): acked. I'm taking this, jumping into the cluster logs now. @Devon H if you get paged pls standby.
Devon H: on phone, 2 min. watching autoscaler and nginx frontends.
María (oncall): quick snapshot: external 504s spiking, tail of nginx shows backend kv-cache misses + gRPC timeouts. P95 latency for embedding calls now 1.8s -> causing upstream timeouts.
Samir Patel: @María any changes from deploys in last 30m? CI shows one config push to ded-eu-3 32m ago (cache TTL tweak) but no model swaps.
María (oncall): nothing else in deploy log. running `kubectl -n redwood logs -l service=embedding-worker --since=15m | grep -i timeout | tail -n 50` — getting KV connection refused + io timeouts.
María (oncall): mitigation plan: (1) divert Nereid traffic to ded-eu-2 (same region, compatible model variant) via routing policy; (2) scale embedding-worker replicas + restart failing pods; (3) update customer comms + status page line. starting diversion now.
Devon H: started route change: `routectl policy apply --from=ded-eu-3 --to=ded-eu-2 --filter=account:nereid-financial --rollout=immediate` — returning 200 for control API.
Incident Bot: route change job accepted (job=rcp-1876543226). Monitoring for error spike.
María (oncall): pods scaling and restarts in flight. I'll monitor KV store; suspect a transient network flap to the managed KV cluster.
Elena (CS): tagging in — need a short tailored customer-facing blurb we can send to Nereid's SOC + account contacts. They require primary phone routing for ops.
María (oncall): draft for status page / customer email: "We are currently mitigating elevated 5xx errors impacting embedding and transform endpoints for your dedicated cluster (ded-eu-3). Traffic for your account is being temporarily routed to a healthy cluster (ded-eu-2) to restore service while we remediate the underlying KV connectivity issue. Expected impact: brief request latency increase (P95 shift up to ~300ms) for affected endpoints during the diversion. No data loss observed. We will follow up with a post-incident summary." Thoughts? :thought_balloon:
Elena (CS): good. edit to add customer-facing SLA note: "We recognize this may affect latency SLAs; we are proactively routing traffic to preserve availability and will credit impacted SLO window per contract if thresholds breached."
Samir Patel: internal note (for legal/support): include exact time window: start 2025-11-12T14:00:10Z divert started 2025-11-12T14:04:00Z; include diagnostic steps and root-cause hypothesis (KV control plane connectivity transient).
Devon H: KV cluster still reporting occasional RSTs, but embedding worker errors dropping post-diversion. P95 now trending down to 600ms.
María (oncall): proceeding to escalate to Platform Lead for a deep-dive. @Claire O will you prepare the tailored contact routing list for Nereid? Need primary/secondary ops and exec contacts + escalation phone numbers.
Claire O: on it. pulled from CRM — sending contact list in thread for CS to use.
Claire O: "Nereid Financial contacts (primary routing):
- Primary Ops: Marcus Li (marcus.li@nereid.com) / +44 7700 900111 (pager)
- Secondary Ops: Priya Agarwal (priya@nereid.com) / +44 7700 900222
- CSM: Elena Ruiz (elena.ruiz@redwood.com) (on copy)
- Executive: CTO - Anders Holm (anders.holm@nereid.com) / +44 7700 900333 (email preferred)"
Elena (CS): perfect. I'll send this short note to Marcus and cc CSM + exec: Subject: [Redwood] Service interruption — Dedicated cluster affected (Nereid Financial)
Elena (CS): Email body (to send now):
"Hi Marcus / team,

We want to let you know we detected elevated 5xx errors impacting your dedicated cluster (ded-eu-3) starting 2025-11-12T14:00:10Z. We have temporarily routed traffic for your account to a healthy cluster (ded-eu-2) to restore availability. You may observe slightly increased latency for embedding/transform requests while this routing is in effect.

What we are doing now: routing to ded-eu-2, scaling/restarting affected pods, and investigating transient KV connectivity to confirm root cause.

No customer data loss has been detected. We will provide a follow-up post-incident summary and SLO impact calculations. If you prefer a call, I am available at +1 415 555 0123.

Apologies for the disruption — Elena (CS)
"
María (oncall): Good. I'm adding suggested status page snippet for public status: "Partial degradation: Dedicated EU cluster experiencing elevated errors impacting a subset of customers. We are routing traffic and expect service to be available while we investigate." Keep it high-level.
Samir Patel: internal template for incident thread (for legal/support ops): "Impact window, affected account(s), mitigation actions taken (route diversion, scale, restart), current state, next steps, owner for postmortem."
Devon H: system checks green after divert; embedding error rate for Nereid down to baseline. Recommend leaving route in place until KV cluster stable for 30m and then failback during low traffic window.
María (oncall): agreed. I'll handoff monitoring to night oncall in 20m. @Devon please document the KV connection traces and add to incident ticket. Creating ticket now.
Incident Bot: Incident ticket created: INC-68291 | owner: María (oncall) | severity: high | linked alert: ded-eu-3-504s-1876543210
María (oncall): Handoff note -> next oncall: watch for error regressions, do not fail back until KV connectivity fully stable and SRE confirms. I will write postmortem draft tomorrow.
Claire O: Adding customer-notify checklist for CS: confirm email sent, log call if requested, update account SLO impact sheet, schedule post-incident review with Nereid if >1hr impact.
Elena (CS): Email sent to Marcus; phone standby. I'll update the account channel and tag execs.
María (oncall): closing loop here — diversion effective, customer notified, scaling in progress. Leaving sticky note on thread for postmortem. Thanks team :thumbsup:
summary: Tailored incident coordination thread for Nereid Financial: paging, runbook steps (route diversion to ded-eu-2), contact routing, customer email draft, status page snippet, handoff and ticket creation.
